basic_details.short_information: Hans Raj College, University of Delhi, has released the written examination schedule for its Non Teaching Recruitment 2026 drive. As per the official notice dated 15 July 2026, the college will conduct the Stage 1 Preliminary Test for five posts - Laboratory Assistant, Administrative Officer, Junior Assistant, Laboratory Attendant, and Library Attendant - between 24 and 26 July 2026. This recruitment is being conducted against Advertisement No. HRC/R(NTS)/005/2025, dated 16 January 2026, for appointment to various Non Teaching posts on a permanent basis.

important_instructions: Candidates are advised to go through the Scheme of Examination/Syllabus available on the official college website before appearing for the test. The admit card must be downloaded from the candidate's dashboard on the recruitment portal using the registered login credentials. The college reserves the right to reject an application or disqualify a candidature at any stage of the recruitment process if the candidate is found ineligible. Any addendum or corrigendum related to this recruitment will be posted only on the official college website (www.hansrajcollege.ac.in); it is the candidate's responsibility to monitor it.

How to Download Hans Raj College Admit Card 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official recruitment portal: https://dunt.uod.ac.in . Log in to your candidate dashboard using your registered login ID and password. Go to the admit card section on your dashboard. Download and take a printout of the admit card for the exam date applicable to your post. Admit cards are available for download from 17 July 2026 (Friday) onwards, as per the official notice.

faq.question: Q1. What is the Hans Raj College Non Teaching exam date in 2026?
faq.answer: The Stage 1 Preliminary Test is scheduled on 24 July 2026 for Laboratory Assistant, 25 July 2026 for Administrative Officer and Junior Assistant, and 26 July 2026 for Laboratory Attendant and Library Attendant.

faq.question: Q2. When can candidates download the Hans Raj College admit card 2026?
faq.answer: The admit card can be downloaded from the candidate's dashboard on dunt.uod.ac.in starting 17 July 2026 (Friday), using the registered login ID and password.

faq.question: Q3. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted under Advertisement No. HRC/R(NTS)/005/2025, dated 16 January 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Is this the final selection exam or just one stage?
faq.answer: The official notice describes it as the "Stage 1 – Preliminary Test," meaning it is not necessarily the final stage of selection. Details of any further stage are not specified in the notice reviewed.

faq.question: Q5. Where can candidates check the syllabus for the preliminary test?
faq.answer: The official notice directs candidates to the Scheme of Examination/Syllabus available on the Hans Raj College website.
